title: Paperwork
focus: 申请 · 手续 · 材料 · 证件 · 预约 · 签字 · 过期 · 办理
body:
The vocabulary of offices, banks and visa counters: what you hand in, what you sign, and what has run out. Sentences bring back 怀疑 from L17 and the job words from L16.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 申请 | shēnqǐng | to apply (for a job, visa, school) | state a request formally |
| 手续 | shǒuxù | formalities / paperwork procedures | steps passed hand to hand |
| 材料 | cáiliào | documents to submit (for an application) | raw material → papers you submit |
| 证件 | zhèngjiàn | ID documents / papers | items that prove who you are |
| 预约 | yùyuē | to make an appointment (in advance) | arrange in advance |
| 签字 | qiānzì | to sign (your name on a document) | sign your characters |
| 过期 | guòqī | to have expired | the period has passed |
| 办理 | bànlǐ | to process / go through (official business, formal) | handle + sort out (formal) |

## Which word?

**预约 vs 预订:** 预约 books a time with a person or office (doctor, bank, visa); 预订 reserves a thing (hotel room, table, ticket).

**办理 vs 办:** same meaning; 办理 is what the sign says, 办 is what people say.

## Sentences

- 我的证件过期了，得重新申请。 wǒ de zhèngjiàn guòqī le, děi chóngxīn shēnqǐng: My ID has expired, so I have to apply again.
- 办签证的手续太麻烦了，我差点崩溃。 bàn qiānzhèng de shǒuxù tài máfan le, wǒ chàdiǎn bēngkuì: The visa paperwork was such a hassle I nearly lost it.
- 材料都准备好了，就差领导签字。 cáiliào dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, jiù chà lǐngdǎo qiānzì: The documents are all ready; we just need the boss's signature.
- 按理说，办理护照不需要预约。 ànlǐ shuō, bànlǐ hùzhào bù xūyào yùyuē: Normally you shouldn't need an appointment to get a passport done.
- 签字之前，一定要把合同看清楚。 qiānzì zhīqián, yídìng yào bǎ hétong kàn qīngchu: Read the contract carefully before you sign.
- 别忘了带证件，否则办不了手续。 bié wàng le dài zhèngjiàn, fǒuzé bàn bù liǎo shǒuxù: Don't forget your ID, or you won't be able to do the paperwork.
- 我怀疑他们根本没看我的材料。 wǒ huáiyí tāmen gēnběn méi kàn wǒ de cáiliào: I suspect they didn't even look at my documents.
- 申请的截止日期快到了，我还在等材料。 shēnqǐng de jiézhǐ rìqī kuài dào le, wǒ hái zài děng cáiliào: The application deadline is coming up and I'm still waiting on documents.

cards.English: to apply (for a job, visa, school)
cards.Example: 他申请了三所大学。 tā shēnqǐng le sān suǒ dàxué: He applied to three universities
cards.Notes: 申 shēn state, declare (申报, 重申) + 请 qǐng request, 讠 (请问, 邀请) = state your request formally. 申请 = formal application; 报名 = report your 名 name: sign up for a class, event or exam

cards.Example: 手续太麻烦了，我跑了三趟。 shǒuxù tài máfan le, wǒ pǎo le sān tàng: The paperwork was such a hassle, I had to go three times
cards.Notes: 手 shǒu hand + 续 xù continue (继续) = steps passed hand to hand one after another. 办手续 = do the paperwork; 入住手续 = check-in

cards.Example: 材料不齐，下次再来吧。 cáiliào bù qí, xià cì zài lái ba: Your documents are incomplete, come back next time
cards.Notes: 材 cái material, 木 timber (身材, 木材) + 料 liào stuff: 米 rice + 斗 measuring scoop (饮料, 原料) = raw material; in bureaucracy, the paperwork you hand in. vs 资料 = information, reference material

cards.Example: 请出示一下您的证件。 qǐng chūshì yíxià nín de zhèngjiàn: Please show your ID
cards.Notes: 证 zhèng proof (证明) + 件 jiàn item (文件, 邮件) = items that prove who you are. Umbrella word for ID card, passport, license; 出示 = present (formal)

cards.Example: 去银行办事最好先预约。 qù yínháng bànshì zuìhǎo xiān yùyuē: Better book an appointment before going to the bank
cards.Notes: 预 yù in advance (预报, 预习) + 约 yuē arrange, agree (约会) = arrange in advance. 预约 = appointment (doctor, bank, office); 预订 = 订 book: reserve (hotel, table, ticket)

cards.English: to sign (your name on a document)
cards.Example: 请在这里签字。 qǐng zài zhèlǐ qiānzì: Please sign here
cards.Notes: 签 qiān sign, ⺮ bamboo (签证) + 字 zì character (写字, 汉字) = sign your characters. 签字 = sign a document; 签名 = signature, also an autograph

cards.Example: 我的驾照过期了，得去换。 wǒ de jiàzhào guòqī le, děi qù huàn: My driver's license expired, I need to renew it
cards.Notes: 过 guò pass (过去, 过年) + 期 qī period (日期) = the period has passed. vs 到期 = 到 arrive + 期: the date arrives, comes due. 过期 also for food

cards.English: to process / go through (official business, formal)
cards.Example: 请问在哪儿办理入住？ qǐngwèn zài nǎr bànlǐ rùzhù: Excuse me, where do I check in?
cards.Notes: 办 bàn handle (办法, 办公室) + 理 lǐ manage, sort out (处理, 管理) = handle and sort out. Formal and written; in speech people say 办

cards.English: My ID has expired, so I have to apply again.
cards.Hanzi: 我的证件过期了，得重新申请。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ de zhèngjiàn guòqī le, děi chóngxīn shēnqǐng.
cards.Notes: 证件 (L18) + 过期 (L18) + 申请 (L18). 得 děi = have to.

cards.English: The visa paperwork was such a hassle I nearly lost it.
cards.Hanzi: 办签证的手续太麻烦了，我差点崩溃。
cards.Pinyin: bàn qiānzhèng de shǒuxù tài máfan le, wǒ chàdiǎn bēngkuì.
cards.Notes: 手续 (L18) + 崩溃 (L15). 办手续 = do the paperwork.

cards.English: The documents are all ready; we just need the boss's signature.
cards.Hanzi: 材料都准备好了，就差领导签字。
cards.Pinyin: cáiliào dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, jiù chà lǐngdǎo qiānzì.
cards.Notes: 材料 (L18) + 签字 (L18) + 领导 (L6). 就差 = all that's missing is.

cards.English: Normally you shouldn't need an appointment to get a passport done.
cards.Hanzi: 按理说，办理护照不需要预约。
cards.Pinyin: ànlǐ shuō, bànlǐ hùzhào bù xūyào yùyuē.
cards.Notes: 办理 (L18) + 预约 (L18) + 按理说 (L14). 按理说 hints 'but in practice…'.

cards.English: Read the contract carefully before you sign.
cards.Hanzi: 签字之前，一定要把合同看清楚。
cards.Pinyin: qiānzì zhīqián, yídìng yào bǎ hétong kàn qīngchu.

cards.English: Don't forget your ID, or you won't be able to do the paperwork.
cards.Hanzi: 别忘了带证件，否则办不了手续。
cards.Pinyin: bié wàng le dài zhèngjiàn, fǒuzé bàn bù liǎo shǒuxù.
cards.Notes: 证件 (L18) + 手续 (L18) + 否则 (L2). 办不了 = can't get done.

cards.English: I suspect they didn't even look at my documents.
cards.Hanzi: 我怀疑他们根本没看我的材料。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ huáiyí tāmen gēnběn méi kàn wǒ de cáiliào.
cards.Notes: 材料 (L18) + 怀疑 (L17). 材料 = papers you submit; 资料 = reference info.

cards.English: The application deadline is coming up and I'm still waiting on documents.
cards.Hanzi: 申请的截止日期快到了，我还在等材料。
cards.Pinyin: shēnqǐng de jiézhǐ rìqī kuài dào le, wǒ hái zài děng cáiliào.
cards.Notes: 申请 (L18) + 材料 (L18) + 截止日期 (L6). 快…了 = about to.
